tasks.subject: Task 0: Prisma schema — country + international review fields
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add `country` to Address, and `country`/`intlReviewRequired`/`intlReviewApproved` to Order, with a migration.

**Files:**
- Modify: `prisma/schema.prisma`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Address.country exists, String @default("IN")
- [ ] Order.country exists, String @default("IN")
- [ ] Order.intlReviewRequired exists, Boolean @default(false)
- [ ] Order.intlReviewApproved exists, Boolean @default(false)
- [ ] Migration applies cleanly to the dev DB

**Verify:** `npx prisma validate`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["prisma/schema.prisma"], "verifyCommand": "npx prisma validate", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Address.country exists, default IN", "Order.country/intlReviewRequired/intlReviewApproved exist", "migration applies cleanly"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Shared address schema — country-aware validation, dedupe
tasks.description:
**Goal:** lib/address-schema.ts's addressSchema validates India addresses strictly and international addresses loosely.

**Files:**
- Modify: `lib/address-schema.ts`
- Test: `__tests__/lib/address-schema.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] country defaults to "IN" when omitted
- [ ] country "IN" enforces existing India regexes (10-digit phone, 6-digit pincode)
- [ ] Other country values skip regexes, only non-empty checks apply
- [ ] Existing India-only callers keep working unchanged

**Verify:** `npx jest __tests__/lib/address-schema.test.ts`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/address-schema.ts", "__tests__/lib/address-schema.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx jest __tests__/lib/address-schema.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["country defaults IN", "IN branch strict regex", "non-IN branch free text", "existing callers unaffected"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Sequel247 pincode-serviceability validation helper
tasks.description:
**Goal:** checkPincodeServiceability(pincode) calls Sequel247's checkServiceability endpoint, soft-fails on network error, caches per pincode.

**Files:**
- Create: `lib/shipping/sequel247-validate.ts`
- Test: `__tests__/lib/shipping/sequel247-validate.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Serviceable pincode returns {ok:true, city, state}
- [ ] "Pincode not found." returns {ok:false, reason:'not_found'}
- [ ] Network error returns {ok:true, skipped:true} (soft-fail)
- [ ] Same pincode cached, no repeat network call

**Verify:** `npx jest __tests__/lib/shipping/sequel247-validate.test.ts`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/shipping/sequel247-validate.ts", "__tests__/lib/shipping/sequel247-validate.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx jest __tests__/lib/shipping/sequel247-validate.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["serviceable pincode ok", "not_found rejected", "network error soft-fails", "per-pincode cache"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Admin — block PREPARING for unapproved international orders
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Admin PATCH transition route refuses PAYMENT_CONFIRMED→PREPARING while intlReviewRequired && !intlReviewApproved; new approve-international endpoint clears it.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/api/admin/orders/[id]/route.ts`
- Create: `app/api/admin/orders/[id]/approve-international/route.ts`
- Test: `__tests__/api/admin/orders-international.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] PATCH to PREPARING blocked (409) when unapproved intl order
- [ ] Same PATCH succeeds after approval
- [ ] approve-international sets intlReviewApproved + appends OrderEvent
- [ ] Domestic orders unaffected

**Verify:** `npx jest __tests__/api/admin/orders-international.test.ts`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/api/admin/orders/[id]/route.ts", "app/api/admin/orders/[id]/approve-international/route.ts", "__tests__/api/admin/orders-international.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx jest __tests__/api/admin/orders-international.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["PREPARING blocked when unapproved", "PREPARING succeeds after approval", "approve endpoint sets flag + event", "domestic orders unaffected"]}
```

tasks.description:

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Real stage checkout with SHIPPING_PROVIDER=sequel247 books + tracks a real UAT shipment
- [ ] International address on stage creates intlReviewRequired order, gate blocks/unblocks correctly
- [ ] Real Razorpay test-mode checkout completes end-to-end
- [ ] Nothing pushed to master

**Verify:** Manual end-to-end sign-off; `npx jest` full suite passes first.
